capabilities: Render Obsidian Markdown as WeChat-ready HTML using 30+ themes, custom CSS/LESS, and style widgets
Upload local images and apply image backgrounds, borders, and watermarks during publishing
Copy the formatted article to the WeChat editor or send it to the Official Account draft box
Convert LaTeX/AsciiMath formulas to SVG and render Mermaid diagrams and Excalidraw drawings for articles
Batch-publish multiple notes and trigger publishing from workflow tools or agents
extras: Some automation features, such as the secure AccessToken interface, are marked as paid member features; deeper guides (style widgets, expert settings, changelog) are linked as separate documents. Sending drafts requires WeChat Official Account API credentials; copy-to-editor does not.
intentEvidence: 还在用微信公众号自带的编辑器写文章吗？五分钟写完内容，半小时调格式
problem: Formatting an article for WeChat Official Account's built-in editor is slow and often pushes writers toward paid template services, and platform-specific markup pollutes otherwise normal notes.
